verdict.rationale: Convertio runs a first-party developer portal (developers.convertio.co) that issues personal API keys, offers official wrappers and a CLI, and documents operations such as OCR via API, with separate API pricing tiers. That is a documented public API a user or agent can drive programmatically. Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt, so the API is documented for humans but not machine-readable. Missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs, endpoint-level reference detail in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
